products.name: Samsung 8 kg front-load washing machine with Eco Bubble, Hygiene Steam and Digital Inverter
products.summary: Open the door to see the diamond drum, pull out the detergent drawer and open the filter cover, then place it in your home at its real size.
products.arTip: Tap the door, the drawer or the filter cover to open it
products.sizeNote: 63.5 cm deep with the door, 107.2 cm with the door open at 90 degrees
specs: Digital Inverter Technology, 10-year warranty on the motor
Eco Bubble, Hygiene Steam, Bubble Soak
Cotton, eCotton, Synthetics, Hygiene Steam, Rinse+Spin, Drain/Spin, Drum Clean, Bedding, Colors, Super Eco Wash, Wool, Delicates, Daily Wash, 15' Quick Wash
Delay End, Easy Iron, Pre Wash, Intensive, Smart Check, Child Lock
Carved door in black, hinged on the left

hotspots.title: Eco Bubble
hotspots.text: Detergent is turned into bubbles, so it quickly penetrates fabric and removes dirt easily, while saving energy and protecting its color and texture.

hotspots.title: Digital Inverter Technology
hotspots.text: It uses strong magnets for a quieter and more powerful performance, but consumes less energy than a Universal Motor, backed up by a 10 year warranty.

hotspots.title: Hygiene Steam
hotspots.text: It releases steam from the bottom of the drum, so every item is thoroughly saturated, removing ingrained grime and 99.9% of bacteria and allergens.

hotspots.title: StayClean Drawer
hotspots.text: More of the detergent is washed away with a specially designed water flushing system, so there's less unsightly soap residue and the tray stays cleaner and more hygienic.

fit.note: From Samsung's manual (DC68-04383A): at least 25 mm at the sides and top, 50 mm behind and 550 mm in front when it stands in an alcove or closet. Samsung gives 63.5 cm deep with the door closed and 107.2 cm with the door open at 90 degrees.
